entryBlocked().details: Blocks new venue entry / forward swaps. Pool: recall only (vault also blocks while      `recoveryObligation` remains). Direct: recall or expiry-with-debt.

recallDeadline().details: `min(maturity, recall)` when both exist. Public recovery and settlement open at `timestamp > due`.

settleDefault().details: Residual collateral returns to the borrower. Remaining debt stays if collateral is insufficient. No write-off.

recallDeadline().notice: Authoritative public-recovery timestamp. Vault, lens, and settlement all use this.

settleDefault().notice: After public recovery opens, convert posted collateral at the accepted oracle to cover remaining debt.
